test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

My father asked how I had done that.

options.text: My father asked, "How I had do that?"
My father asked "How I did this".
My father asked "How I had done that".
My father asked, "How did you do this?"

solution:
The correct answer is **"My father asked, **"**How did you do this?**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is an example of **indirect speech**, which means that it **reports someone else's words or thoughts**.
 
• To convert **indirect speech into direct speech**, we need to follow certain rules, such as using inver
